title: Bound a EUR world-record list insertion
changes: Identify a separate world-record-derived insertion and the original list reset, while retaining live-index and restoration limits.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-world-id-domain-wine-m8am6hhs authenticates 31 existing world records and finds their low-ten-bit IDs in 0..358.
Wine e158-byte00-list-second-source-dis-wine-1jq3_d11 and e158-byte00-list-storage-writers-dis-wine-rwpkftan inspect the source and copy path.

Wine e158-byte00-list-reset-dis-wine-oc803tkd, e158-byte00-list-reset-caller-dis-wine-cy1tqrkx and e158-byte00-list-caller-scan-wine-9p3cag2u inspect the conditional reset and bounded caller candidates; ygyq6pf2 and zwt6r7cc retain reference and refresh windows.
limitations: The world insertion bound assumes a 0..30 live index and stable scratch data. Reset execution, later restoration, alternate indices, aliases, other writers and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
